description:
Finding: crates/smtp/src/sieve_admin.rs defines a private is_loopback_addr (lines 38-45) that is a verbatim copy of stoa_core::util::is_loopback_addr. The smtp crate already depends on stoa_core (RuntimeEnvironment::from_env is called in smtp/src/main.rs line 61). The duplicate is never re-exported so it provides no isolation benefit.

Impact: Two copies of the same logic must be kept in sync. If the canonical version in stoa_core is ever corrected (e.g. for an edge case in IPv6 bracket handling), the smtp copy silently diverges. Replace the private copy with a direct call to stoa_core::util::is_loopback_addr.
title: Remove duplicate is_loopback_addr in smtp/sieve_admin
